purpose: Quantify twilight sky-radiance and derived Level-B sensitivity to independently defined normalized aerosol vertical optical-depth shape at fixed total AOD and fixed rich OPAC spectral/phase optical properties, without fitting Taylor/Jerusalem and without modifying production Level-B.
scientificQuestion: At fixed total AOD550 and fixed OPAC continental_average wavelength-dependent aerosol optical properties/phase function, how much does an independently defined normalized aerosol vertical optical-depth template change twilight radiance and derived Level-B limiting magnitude across the frozen geometry/AOD screen?

literatureBasis.source: Hess, Koepke & Schult (1998), Optical Properties of Aerosols and Clouds: The Software Package OPAC, Bulletin of the American Meteorological Society 79(5), 831-844
literatureBasis.interpretationBoundary: The five states are OPAC-derived vertical-template controls. They are not claims that the fixed continental_average optical family physically co-occurs with maritime/desert/arctic/antarctic climatology at a real site. Cross-combination is deliberate to isolate vertical shape.

fixedOpticalFamily.customVerticalDirective: aerosol_file tau <case-specific normalized vertical template file>
fixedOpticalFamily.reason: Use one already-runtime-validated physically coherent wavelength-dependent OPAC optical family in every state so the planned contrast isolates vertical optical-depth distribution rather than SSA/phase/family changes.

profileConstruction.firstLayer: For each state distribute the derived first-layer tau over [0,H] in proportion to exp(-h/Z) using the OPAC Table-5 H and Z.
profileConstruction.freeTroposphere: Distribute tau550=0.013 over [H,12 km] in proportion to exp(-h/8 km).
profileConstruction.stratosphere: Distribute tau550=0.005 over [12,35 km] in proportion to exp(-h/99 km).
profileConstruction.above35Km: zero aerosol tau in the custom profile
profileConstruction.normalization: The assembled source-state tau profile is normalized to unit column optical-depth fractions before case AOD550 is imposed by aerosol_set_tau_at_wvl.
profileConstruction.renderConvention: merged generic profile-transport lower-bound aerosol_file tau convention with zero at the top atmosphere boundary
profileConstruction.observerClipping: not exercised in v1; observerElevationM is frozen at sea level. Elevated-observer interaction is a separate later experiment only if v1 profile sensitivity is material.

fixedNumericalAndPhysicalDesign.designReuseReason: Reuse the already-reviewed AOPS/AFPF geometry, AOD, spectral and photon design to isolate the new vertical-profile dimension without introducing a new geometry screen.

spectralEvidence.reason: Raw spectral evidence is retained for audit; ASIV ordinal39 did not validate arbitrary full-spectrum production interpolation.

primaryContrasts.referenceContrasts: For each cell and replicate, compute paired log(alternative/reference) for all three primary sky channels for each of the four alternative vertical templates.
primaryContrasts.pairwiseDiagnosticContrasts: All state-pair contrasts may be reported descriptively from the same frozen cases, but only reference contrasts are primary.
primaryContrasts.uncertainty: Retain all three CRN-paired replicate contrasts; report mean, sample SD and SE=SD/sqrt(3). No independent-error quadrature, p-values or confidence intervals.

secondaryLevelBEndpoint.model: Crumey 2014 Eq.34 full branch through current Level-B threshold path
secondaryLevelBEndpoint.interpretation: Paired magnitude delta is the intended fast-model visibility sensitivity. No universal minute conversion is allowed; any future time conversion requires an actual date/location solar-depression rate and a separately frozen mapping.

numericRules.reasonNoMaterialityThreshold: This stage is a quantitative physical sensitivity characterization. No pre-existing governance threshold defines when vertical structure must become a production dimension; mapper selection is a later separately frozen engineering/science decision.

nextReviewRequirements: Verify the OPAC-derived template generator exactly reproduces Table-3 component optical-depth shares on a grid containing all layer boundaries.
Bind the exact current-main vertical transport module and renderer hashes.
Review whether 20M photons x 360 cases remains numerically and operationally appropriate given prior AOPS/AFPF experience; any change must occur before seed allocation/result opening.
Only after tracked-tree freeze allocate 72 fresh CRN group seeds and perform repository-global collision audit.
Allocate a fresh scientific ordinal only in a separate authorization review.
